Questions and general support are handled in the
[Freetz-EVO discussions](https://github.com/Ircama/freetz-evo/discussions).

Please **open a discussion** instead of an issue for:

- "How do I ...?" questions
- Help with flashing, configuring, or building
- Package installation and compatibility questions
- Anything that is not a concrete bug or a feature request

When posting a discussion, please include:

- Your device model and firmware series (e.g. 7590 AX, 08_2X)
- Your build configuration (`.config`) if relevant
- What you already tried

Issues are reserved for confirmed bugs and feature requests.
